headlines.title: Trump uses antisemitic slur in defending Sen. Marshall
headlines.description: President Donald Trump used an antisemitic slur in defending Sen. Roger Marshall, R-Kan., during a rally in Kansas, following an article that said he sued hundreds of patients over unpaid debts when he was a practicing physician.

headlines.title: Kansas voters stress affordability as key issue in competitive Senate race
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is headed to Kansas in support of incumbent GOP Sen. Roger Marshall, who is in a tight race against his Democratic challenger, Adam Hamilton. NBC News' Stephanie Gosk spoke with voters who emphasized affordability as a key issue in the race.

headlines.title: Richard Riehle, character actor best known for ‘Office Space,’ dies at 78
headlines.description: He racked up more than 400 film and television credits in a screen career spanning more than 40 years.

headlines.title: Tampa Bay Rays advance to World Series, will face Milwaukee Brewers
headlines.description: The Tampa Bay Rays will play the Milwaukee Brewers in the 2026 World Series after the Rays defeated the Cleveland Guardians to win the American League Championship Series.

headlines.title: Trump pardons two vehicle repair shop owners during Alaska rally
headlines.description: During his rally in Alaska, President Trump pardoned Zachary Czuback and Patrick Fleming, co-owners of a vehicle repair shop in Anchorage. Both pleaded guilty in 2022 to violating the Clean Air Act by tampering with federally mandated and monitored devices that tracked vehicles’ diesel emissions.

headlines.title: Vance declines to endorse Netanyahu after Trump offers full support for re-election
headlines.description: Vance, who campaigned for ousted Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán this spring, said he endorses American candidates.

headlines.description: Trump had used the term during a speech last year, leading to backlash. He said at the time that he wasn’t aware of the word’s antisemitic connotations.

headlines.title: Nearly $1M in sports, Pokémon cards stolen from FedEx truck in California
headlines.description: Thieves made off with nearly $1 million in sports, Pokémon and other trading cards swiped from a FedEx truck in Southern California last week, police said Monday.

headlines.title: Vegas tourist who took Peachy the flamingo from hotel exhibit is found guilty of animal cruelty
headlines.description: Mitchell Fairbarn took the bird from the Flamingo Las Vegas Hotel and Casino and carried it to his room. His lawyer said he was intoxicated and meant no harm.

headlines.title: Judge likely to extend block on golf course tree clearing in a clash over Trump’s redesign
headlines.description: The judge said the administration’s argument that the downing of hundreds of trees at the golf course was unrelated to Trump’s renovation plan wasn’t credible.

headlines.title: 17 best deals from Amazon’s Holiday Beauty Event, according to a beauty editor
headlines.description: We rounded up the best deals on skin care, makeup, hair care and more from Amazon’s Holiday Beauty Event, including favorites from Medicube, Tarte, Clinique and more.
